title: Open Access Theses and Dissertations

title: L2 Syntactical Complexity Analyzer
description: The L2 Syntactic Complexity Analyzer (L2SCA), developed by Professor Xiaofei Lu at The Pennsylvania State University, is a tool that allows language teachers and researchers to analyze the syntactic complexity of written English language samples, using 14 different measures covering (1) length of production units, (2) amounts of coordination, (3) amounts of subordination, (4) degree of phrasal sophistication and overall sentence complexity.

title: Arabic and Darija NLP Resources

title: OpenSLR
